name: tpl-precedence-4-goal
task: Reach the exit, but you must have flipped the switch first.
texts: The agent must eventually be on the exit cell.
The switch must be toggled before the agent reaches the exit.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u3
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled) -> u2
(u0, at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u3
(u1, at_exit) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&switch_toggled, u1) -> 1
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled, u2) -> -10
(u0, at_exit&switch_toggled, u3) -> 12
(u1, at_exit, u3) -> 11
